entries.rationale: Container sprawl wastes resources. SS QLM standardizes the use of '--rm' for development tasks and explicit naming for lifecycle tracking.
Passing secrets as environment variables in the command line exposes them to 'ps' and shell history. SS QLM mandates the use of protected env-files or secret mounts.
Race conditions occur when the orchestration completes before the service is ready. SS QLM requires explicit port/health polling before dependent execution.
